title: A session's explicit claim selection (work_binding) is runtime-only and is not preserved across a host restart
outcome: After a host restart, a session whose holder explicitly selected a held claim (by naming its worktree) opens its next turn on that selection, or on a documented, deterministic fallback, instead of whatever the restore rule happens to re-derive; a consumed selection is never resurrected over a later focus change.
acceptance: A behavioural test restarts the host (state round-trip) between an acknowledged explicit naming of claim B and the session's next turn, and the next turn opens on B with the change stamped and committed
A behavioural test shows a selection already consumed by an opening is not resurrected after a restart over a later focus change back to A
Old writers and readers stay compatible with any persisted form, per the schema ledger; existing named-root and binding tests stay green
